observation: The early Coin 2 variant enters a high-frequency 0x0013FC/0x001404 polling loop over 0x60c001; the normal coin-start path reaches the 0x02C1A0/0x02C1EE input checks instead.
notes: The 0x0013EC routine statically tests status/input bits 2 and 5; it is not identified as a credit handler.
This differential does not yet establish why the normal Coin 1 path leaves the displayed credit count unchanged.
